text_block_list.text:
"On a certain autumn rest day, while 
training for the Shinzan Kinen—"

"Uncharacteristically, Gentildonna paid a 
visit to the Trainer's office."

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: Hello.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: May I ask what your plans are after this?

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: I see.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
If that's the case, it's a good time for 
it... How about taking a short break?

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Perhaps while enjoying some chrysanthemum 
herbal tea.

The first thing that comes to mind from 
that word... is the final leg of the 
Classic Triple Crown taking place today—

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Looks like we might get some amusing 
entertainment to go along with our tea, 
don't you think?

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
—This year's "Kikuka Sho" will go down in 
history.

At Gentildonna's request, we moved to an 
upscale lounge she claims to frequent—

text_block_list.name: Staff
text_block_list.text:
—Lady Gentil, Trainer. Tea and the 
monitors are ready for you.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: Thank you.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
You're nervous. You're not hiding it well 
at all.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Exposing your weakness is a poor move. If 
you cannot change your mindset, at least 
put on a brave front.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: Well then, let us have some tea brewed.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
"This is really interesting, you know. 
Look..."

Hot water was poured into the clear 
teapot. And then, the golden flower inside 
bloomed with breathtaking beauty.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Chuckle. The petals all line up just like 
a crown.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
I wonder if I'll ever behold a crown more 
flawless than this—

The lounge monitor displays Kyoto 
Racecourse. An earth-shattering roar from 
the crowd... You can feel the anticipation 
for the birth of a Triple Crown Umamusume.

—Just as the excitement in the venue 
reached its peak, the gates opened.

"The much-watched Orfevre took a good 
position and blended into the pack with 
eerie calm... but once she hit the final 
straight, it was all over in a flash."

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
It's Orfevre!! Orfevre has broken away!! 
She's pulling further and further 
ahead...!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
"Orfevre! It's Orfevre!! —There is no one 
who can catch her now!!"

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
“The winner is Orfevre--!! She has 
achieved the Triple Crown...!”
(Oooooohhhh...!)

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: Shut up.
(*Thwack!*)

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
W-What is this, Orfevre?! She just kicked 
off the inner rail—?!

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
Don't make a fuss over something like 
this.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
The Triple Crown was mine from the very 
beginning. It merely took physical form. 
Therefore...

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: Kneel swiftly. Before my crown.

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text: Such tyranny, yet such majesty...!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
I have never seen a Triple Crown Umamusume 
like this...!

—I relax and lean deep into the backrest. 
The buzz of the venue fades away, and 
echoing in its place is...

"The roar of the final straight. Orfevre's 
flawless, overwhelmingly dominant run...—"
choice_data_list: (How are we supposed to beat that...?!)
(How are we supposed to beat that...?!)

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: —Heh.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: Fufu...!

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: Ohohoho!

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
"Such courage, and such strength... Truly, 
the strongest of 'the now'."

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
"Ah, truly magnificent... It far exceeds 
my imagination, Orfevre-san."

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Things have become surprisingly simple 
now.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
If I beat her, then I'm the strongest. 
—Isn't that right?

A shiver ran down my spine. Even after 
witnessing Orfevre's spectacular run... 
Gentildonna remained completely unshaken.

It felt as though Orfevre's Triple Crown 
had been achieved solely to become 
nourishment for her—

At that moment, a vision appeared before 
me. A vision of Orfevre, who had claimed 
the Classic Triple Crown today, and—

"Carrying matching 'crowns,' Gentildonna 
stands before the king..."

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. 'The strongest'... What a thrilling 
ring that has to it.
choice_data_list:
Why do you seek strength to such an 
extent?

Why do you seek strength to such an 
extent?

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: There's no need to even ask, is there?

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Unbalanced power exists in this world, and 
I possess both the means and the talent to 
claim it.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
And yet, how can you remain so powerless? 
How can you tolerate the existence of 
those stronger than yourself?

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
A true lady, you see, 'has' even kings 
escort her.

—I can ignite Gentildonna's confidence and 
fighting spirit. My duty is to bring her 
before the king and guide her to victory.
choice_data_list: Then I'll set the stage for you.
Then I'll set the stage for you.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: ...Heh.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
It doesn't seem like she's merely putting 
on a brave face.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: My tea has gone cold. Let's head back.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: —Ah, yes. About today's race, though...
choice_data_list: I already sent over the analysis data.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Heh... I see. I just hope you didn't rush 
and make a mess of it.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
I can hardly wait for the day we drag that 
arrogant king off her throne.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: ...A king?

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
"Aren't they talking about Orfe-san? It's 
amazing, isn't it? The Classic Triple 
Crown!"

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
“Still, drag them down, you say...? More 
importantly, right now we should—”

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: ...Ah, I see. So that's...

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Huh, Big Sis?

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
She is already looking... beyond the Tiara 
route. Which means—

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
"I take it the Tiara route is an easy walk 
in the park for you, then?"

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
...I will make you regret this. You shall 
never stand before the King—because!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
"Because before that, I will drag them 
down!"
